subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers ask the contributor to rebase and port this PR to src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts with real proof, or adopt the fix in a fresh maintainer branch?
rationale: The PR is assigned, dirty against main, and missing proof that requires real Copilot credentials; automation should not choose contributor refresh versus maintainer replacement on its own.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor move the fingerprint/cache-ownership guard into src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts, preserve integrationId/domain checks, add active-path tests, and update the PR body with redacted runtime proof.

options.title: Maintainer replacement
options.body: A maintainer can land a fresh narrow PR against current main if the bug is urgent or the contributor branch remains stale.

options.title: Leave blocked for now
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked while the canonical issue remains open and revisit closure only after maintainer follow-up expires.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor move the fingerprint/cache-ownership guard into src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts, preserve integrationId/domain checks, add active-path tests, and update the PR body with redacted runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has adjacent history on the provider helper refactors this PR needs to follow.
